Kolkata Film Institute Classes Suspended Amid Campus Violence

Classes at a film institute in Kolkata have been suspended for a sixth consecutive day following incidents of campus violence. Students have reported being "slashed, beaten, and had their heads split open" during a mob attack on the campus.
